status: Pilot complete; not accepted as production RGB replacement or physical robot demonstration
request: Try established retargeting methods on the poor connected R1/Sharpa EgoDex result
versions: Exact upstream revisions, adapter SHA256 and robot/method configurations are saved in each result directory

protocol.robot_base: Fixed for the clip from mean human shoulder landmarks; native robot shoulder width
protocol.wrist_calibration: Per-frame rigid Kabsch fit to palm anchors, without scaling
protocol.paper_actual_distance: Author-provided ablation option 2; preserves original thumb-to-finger distances instead of shrinking them
adaptations: Generated R1 plus Sharpa kinematic URDF matching existing renderer
Mapped human landmarks to Sharpa wrist, finger bases and tips
Published task-space objective weights and optimizer code unchanged
Robot-specific posture regularization weights set to zero; velocity weights 0.1 arm, 0.01 finger
Disabled low-pass output filtering for dex-retargeting
Strict limits through upstream epsilon=0 API; clip only next optimizer initial guess to avoid float32 roundoff outside float64 bounds

verification.fk: Both upstream Pinocchio and rendered FK agree below 1e-8 across random joint configurations
verification.media: ffprobe confirms 33 frames at 15 fps; inspected beginning/middle/end stills and enlarged right-hand comparisons
verification.projection: Camera inverse and perspective projection checked against official EgoDex data_utils.py and draw_utils.py

judgment.kinematic_fit: Paper objectives substantially improve fingertip direction and position agreement with EgoDex 3D annotations on these two clips
judgment.example_chopsticks_right: Position baseline: 8.05 mm / 35.97 degrees. Paper actual-distance: 0.59 mm / 3.70 degrees. These are annotation-fit errors, NOT physical grasp or RGB ground-truth errors
judgment.temporal_caveat: Bottle right-hand joint-step p95 is worse for paper actual-distance (0.203 rad) than position (0.146 rad); no universal smoothness improvement claimed
judgment.visual_failure: Directly reprojecting original EgoDex hand points already misaligns multiple visible fingers in the RGB. A better optimizer faithfully reproduces that mismatch
judgment.official_caveat: EgoDex README explicitly warns of perspective mismatch caused by Vision Pro multi-camera synthesized RGB. This does not prove the 3D labels themselves are incorrect
judgment.archived_baseline: Different arm/hand scale and wrist proportions; qualitative reference only, not an isolated algorithm ablation

next_research: Treat EgoDex 3D pose as a prior, not exact pixel-aligned truth
Evaluate independent RGB hand observations and camera/reprojection refinement without changing physical robot dimensions
Separate robot kinematic trajectory generation from pixel-aligned counterfactual video editing
Only add physical object-contact optimization once object geometry and motion are estimated
Do not scale to the full EgoDex dataset or declare grasp success based on annotation-fit metrics
safety_and_scope: No training restart, no existing outputs overwritten, no production pipeline replacement, no commit or push. All media remain local research artifacts. Review dataset derivative redistribution rights separately before any publication.
